inv.desc_en:
Retail rents an excellent commercial space located on Clara del Rey street, in the heart of the Chamartín district, in the Prosperidad neighborhood, with a strategic location offering great commercial visibility, heavy daily foot traffic, and a consolidated residential and business environment that guarantees a high influx of customers.

Features:

- Surface area: 320 m² total, distributed as 126 m² on the ground floor and 193 m² in the basement.
- Facade: 5 linear meters.
- Height: 3 meters.
- Smoke vent: No.
- Open-plan space.
- Guarantees: 2 months of legal deposit + 6 months of additional guarantee.
- Very well connected by metro, bus, and commuter rail (cercanías).
- Key Planning: BANCO SANTANDER, SUPERCOR, DRUNI, VIPS, 100 MONTADITOS, GENERAL ÓPTICA, PHARMACY, EL OBRADOR DE GOYA, MON PARNASSE FLORES, VANILLE BAKERY LAB, MAISON DE NEM NEM, ETC.

Call us to arrange a visit.

Retail is a leading specialist in commercial premises, business expansion, and investment, with more than 2,350 successful operations carried out over our more than 22 years of experience in the real estate market. We have more premises available on the most commercial streets throughout Madrid.
